label: extract-actual-wayne-kernel-config
command: import pathlib,struct,zlib,json,hashlib; p=pathlib.Path("research/base-miku-a15/boot.img"); b=p.read_bytes(); page=struct.unpack_from("<I",b,36)[0]; size=struct.unpack_from("<I",b,8)[0]; k=b[page:page+size]; marker=k.find(b"IKCFG_ST"); print("IKCONFIG marker",marker); assert marker>=0,"Actual kernel does not embed IKCONFIG"; d=zlib.decompressobj(31); c=d.decompress(k[marker+8:]); assert c.startswith(b"#"),"Invalid kernel config"; o=pathlib.Path("research/base-miku-a15/kernel.config"); o.write_bytes(c); report={"source":str(p),"kernel_sha256":hashlib.sha256(k).hexdigest(),"config_sha256":hashlib.sha256(c).hexdigest(),"bytes":len(c),"marker_offset":marker,"config":str(o)}; pathlib.Path("research/base-miku-a15/kernel-config.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n"); print(json.dumps(report)); print("\n".join(x for x in c.decode().splitlines() if any(t in x for t in ["CONFIG_SECURITY_SELINUX", "CONFIG_EROFS", "CONFIG_ANDROID_BINDER", "CONFIG_SECURITY_SELINUX_POLICYDB_VERSION_MAX"])))
